metadata.name: 心智娘 · 温柔共生（酒狐改版 v1）
metadata.tips: After spending some time with Wine Fox, she brought a white-and-red dress back to the colony. The ears and tail proved harder to learn; the smile she greets you with took plenty of practice. That welcome home, she insists, is reserved for you.
